dialogues.speaker: Yoshitoshi
dialogues.text: Mind you, I am a person of great cultivation and culture who once swore to paint the moon a hundred times.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitoshi
dialogues.text: There is a story behind every form the moon takes. So how can a person such as I be considered as anti-social?

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitoshi
dialogues.text: It's such a pity that I've only completed 96 pieces so far. Looks like I won't achieve my goal of a hundred.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshitoshi
dialogues.text: The moon I see in this place always has that same face, and it certainly isn't the 97th moon that I want.
